facts.fact: Graphic Online reports the National Identification Authority enforcing, from 2 November 2026 under L.I. 2523, verification of Ghana Cards through its mandated NIA Identity Verification System Platform, with biometric verification, in place of photocopying or visual inspection.

GHA.note: No enrolment count or share given.
Operator, maintenance and ownership not stated.
No public register keyed on the ID number stated.
Names the Ghana Card but not its issuance, biometric enrolment checks or certification.
Article urges institutions to onboard to the platform and enforces the mandate; it does not say any are verifying yet.
